before: I can ask for the same thing in a friend way and a teacher way.
after: I can ask for the same thing with a named friend and teacher, using words that fit each situation.

before: Read one exact phrase card without naming its listener. Children point to the listener they think fits. Reveal the match and ask one child to explain the clue.
after: Read a phrase and its supplied relationship context. Children name the listener and explain the context clue. Try the phrase with another listener and accept more than one fitting choice; politeness alone does not identify a relationship.
